content_sections.heading: MOIL Recruitment 2026 How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for MOIL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.moil.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 06-11-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Manganese Ore India (MOIL), a prominent public sector undertaking, to fill various engineering project roles on a fixed-term contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MOIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies available across different designations, including Project Engineer and Senior Project Engineer positions in both Mechanical and Electrical engineering disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of the completed offline application form along with necessary enclosures is 6 November 2026. Applicants must ensure timely postal submission.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Project Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E or B.Tech degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or an equivalent qualification from a recognized university or institute along with required post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for Project Engineer posts will receive a salary of ₹1,14,420 per month, while Senior Project Engineer posts offer ₹1,33,490 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for applying to MOIL?
faq.answer: Yes, general, EWS, and OBC candidates are required to pay an application fee of ₹826/- via Demand Draft. SC, ST, PwBD, and departmental candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for Senior Project Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for Senior Project Engineer positions is 40 years as on the specified crucial date of 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for MOIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Candidates must download the application format, fill it out, attach documents, and send it by post to the designated Nagpur address.

faq.question: Q9. What is the initial tenure of employment on these contract posts?
faq.answer: The initial tenure of engagement for selected engineers shall be up to three years, which may be further extended based on performance reviews and company requirements.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the completed offline application be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent by post or delivered in person to the General Manager (Mines) & Additional Charge HoD (Pers.), MOIL Ltd, MOIL Bhavan, 1-A, Katol Road, Nagpur-440 013.
